Datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
Datenschutz.intro: This app is local-first. How we handle data:
Datenschutz.localText: Your project (location, roof, modules, consumption) is stored only locally in your browser (IndexedDB). It leaves your device only if you export it or create an account.
Datenschutz.externalText: For calculations, requests go to Photon/OpenStreetMap (geocoding, footprint) and PVGIS (yield). Addresses are transmitted for this but not stored permanently. The map loads tiles from OpenStreetMap.
Datenschutz.analyticsText: No tracking, no ads, no analytics cookies in the MVP. Only a local notice-acknowledged flag is stored in the browser.
Datenschutz.rightsText: Since no personal data is stored server-side, you can delete your data anytime via the app (clear browser data).
